events.message: Can't place: Must sit on a building — not an empty street or plaza.

controls.tooltip:
Mirai Dropper
The Mirai botnet: default-password cameras and routers conscripted by the thousand. Each pwned device donates Cycles.
Cost: 10 Cycles

Poisoned Package
A typosquatted npm package quietly pulled into a thousand CI builds. A supply-chain compromise — big Cycles.
Cost: 40 Cycles, 10 Intel, 40 Cash

Cloud Cryptojacker
Stolen cloud keys spin up racks of instances on someone else's bill. Heavy Cycles.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 10 Intel, 60 Cash

Phishing Kit
An Emotet-style mail lure sprayed across an office. Sweeps Intel from inboxes in range.
Cost: 12 Cycles

Scraper Botnet
Credential-stuffing bots grinding leaked dumps against logins across the feeds. Sweeps Intel in range.
Cost: 15 Cycles

Magecart Skimmer
A few lines of JavaScript on a checkout page. Skims card data — pays out in Crypto.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 20 Intel, 30 Cash

controls.tooltip:
DNS Tunnel
iodine-style: data smuggled inside DNS queries. Small, cheap, silent.
Cost: 5 Cycles

VPN Tunnel
WireGuard: an encrypted link. Medium throughput, and it actively COOLS your Trace.
Cost: 20 Cycles, 10 Cash

Reverse Shell
A fat pipe straight back to C2. Fast — and LOUD (raises Trace).
Cost: 20 Cycles, 10 Cash

HTTP/2 Flood
A multiplexed firehose. Huge throughput, pricey, moderately loud.
Cost: 35 Cycles, 25 Cash

Onion Route
Bounces through many hops — reaches far-off districts, costs a Tool.
Cost: 25 Cycles, 15 Cash, 1 Tools
